newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - British Steel seen cut at BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - British Steel seen cut at BZW.

text.p: Earnings estimates for British Steel Plc were cut at BZW because of weaker-than-expected steel prices, market sources said on Friday.
For the year ended March 1997, BZW cut its forecast for pre-tax profit by some 150 million stg to 580 million and for the year after it cut by a similar amount to 700 million.
It repeated a "hold" recommendation on the stock.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment. The stock was up 2-3/4p at 193 in a strong overall market, with the FTSE 100 setting an intraday record.
